paths.name: Conservative: Defer & Reduce
paths.approach_description: Defer the two planned projects (Data Warehouse Consolidation and AI/ML Lab) to next fiscal year and reduce consulting spend by 15% across the three highest-consulting projects. This avoids disrupting any active projects.
paths.trade_offs: Delays strategic initiatives by 6-12 months. Consulting reduction may slow some project deliveries. No impact on active project timelines or headcount.

paths.name: Moderate: Targeted Cuts & Optimization
paths.approach_description: Remove the AI/ML Lab, defer Data Warehouse by 6 months, pause the Telematics Dashboard for 3 months, and apply a 10% across-the-board cut to all external costs. Optimizes current portfolio without eliminating active work.
paths.trade_offs: Telematics Dashboard delayed by ~3 months. External vendor relationships may need renegotiation. Some amber projects may shift toward red temporarily.

headline_numbers.rag_changes: 1 project may shift Green to Amber

paths.name: Aggressive: Deep Portfolio Restructuring
paths.approach_description: Apply a 20% across-the-board budget cut to all active and planned projects. This achieves maximum savings but significantly impacts delivery timelines and team utilization across all cost centers.
paths.trade_offs: High risk of delivery delays across the portfolio. Multiple projects may shift to Red RAG. Significant under-utilization in several cost centers. May require staff reallocation or reduction.

headline_numbers.capacity_impact: Reduces demand by 8.5 FTE across all CCs
headline_numbers.rag_changes: 3 projects shift to Red, 4 to Amber

paths.name: Redistribute: Cross-CC Resource Sharing
paths.approach_description: Shift 2 resources from the over-utilized MUC AppDev team to under-utilized Budapest AppDev for Q2 2026. Delays non-critical ERP work by 1 month to create breathing room.
paths.trade_offs: ERP Phase 2 timeline extends by 1 month. Cross-location coordination overhead. Budapest team needs onboarding time for ERP context.

headline_numbers.capacity_impact: MUC AppDev drops from 105% to 88%, BUD AppDev rises from 78% to 85%

paths.name: Defer: Push Non-Essential Work to Q3
paths.approach_description: Defer the start of Data Warehouse Consolidation by 3 months and reduce Sensor Data Pipeline resource allocation by 20% in Q2. This relieves pressure on MUC AppDev without impacting critical path projects.
paths.trade_offs: Data Warehouse project starts later. Sensor pipeline development velocity reduced temporarily. Freed capacity could be used for ERP testing push.

headline_numbers.capacity_impact: MUC AppDev drops from 105% to 90%, overall portfolio at 84%

paths.name: Accelerate: Fast-Track Rail Diagnostics
paths.approach_description: Accelerate Rail Diagnostics Platform by 3 months and increase its budget by 200K to bring in additional developer capacity. Fund this by reducing the Fleet Portal v2 budget by 10% and deferring the AI/ML Lab.
paths.trade_offs: Fleet Portal v2 scope reduced. AI/ML Lab delayed indefinitely. Rail-focused cost centers see increased utilization.

headline_numbers.rag_changes: Fleet Portal may shift Green to Amber

paths.name: Balanced: Incremental Rail Investment
paths.approach_description: Increase Predictive Maintenance PoC budget by 100K for additional ML training data and infrastructure, funded by a 5% consulting reduction across non-Rail projects.
paths.trade_offs: Minor consulting reduction in non-Rail projects. Overall portfolio budget stays roughly flat. No timeline impacts.

headline_numbers.capacity_impact: Minimal — additional budget goes to external costs

goal_display: Rebalance Master Data Hub BTC across DE/PL/CZ

paths.name: Conservative: Shift 10pp from DE-Munich onto PL/CZ
paths.approach_description: Lever 12 demo. Reduce Master Data Hub (off-mdh) BTC line for DE-Munich by 10 percentage points and split that capacity onto Poznan (+5pp) and Prague (+5pp). Promotes shifts ~€283k of annual Stage-2 charge from the DE legal entity onto PL+CZ legal entities. Stays within the existing 3 charging-location set.
paths.trade_offs: DE-Munich legal entity sees ~€283k less inflow next fiscal year — could trigger a margin renegotiation. PL and CZ legal entities each absorb ~€142k more cost; ensure tax & invoicing setup is in place. No project-level changes required; canonical forecast unaffected until promote.

headline_numbers.capacity_impact: No FTE shift — pure cost-allocation rebalance
headline_numbers.rag_changes: No RAG changes; ~€283k of annual Stage-2 charge re-routed across legal entities

paths.name: Moderate: Shift 5pp from DE-Munich onto broader EMEA
paths.approach_description: Lighter rebalance: reduce DE-Munich by 5pp and distribute the freed capacity across the broader EMEA footprint (Poznan +2pp, Prague +2pp, Frankfurt +1pp). Smaller magnitude shift but spreads cost across three additional charging locations.
paths.trade_offs: DE-Munich legal entity sees ~€114k less inflow. PL/CZ/DE-FRA share the absorption. Smaller margin impact on each landing legal entity; correspondingly smaller diversification benefit.

headline_numbers.capacity_impact: No FTE shift — pure cost-allocation rebalance
headline_numbers.rag_changes: No RAG changes; ~€114k of annual Stage-2 charge re-routed

paths.name: Fund It: Increase ERP Budget
paths.approach_description: Increase ERP Phase 2 budget by 150K to cover the over-run trajectory and extend the timeline by 2 months. Fund the increase from the planned AI/ML Lab budget. This directly addresses the root cause of the Red RAG status.
paths.trade_offs: AI/ML Lab budget reduced or deferred. ERP end date moves from Sep to Nov 2026. Addresses the core issue rather than masking it.

headline_numbers.capacity_impact: MUC AppDev utilization extends 2 months longer
headline_numbers.rag_changes: ERP Phase 2 moves from Red to Amber

paths.name: Reduce Scope: Trim ERP Non-Essentials
paths.approach_description: Reduce ERP Phase 2 scope by cutting 20% of external costs (consulting and training) and reducing Senior Developer allocation by 15 hours/month. This brings forecast back within budget ceiling without additional funding.
paths.trade_offs: Some ERP features may be deferred to a Phase 3. Reduced consulting may slow SAP integration specialist support. Risk of quality impact if scope reduction is not carefully managed.

headline_numbers.rag_changes: ERP Phase 2 moves from Red to Amber
